integrity_notes: Direct curvature computation, exact polynomial/Descartes root count and local implicit-function expansion supply proof. Standalone arithmetic and vector checks supplement the proof. Historical-priority assessment is provisional; no external validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the standard smooth (2,3) circular ring-torus trefoil with major/minor radius ratio R>1. The topological local extrema count includes three nondifferentiable curvature-zero minima at R=13/4. Other knot embeddings and energy-minimizing trefoils are outside the theorem.
title: A sharp curvature-vertex bifurcation for the standard circular trefoil
